svg.title: Step 7: Approval and tracking (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 7 Approval and tracking. Now: lead-approve takes draft IDs in JSON; Caps skipped without schedule-set; Envelope has no job_id; Replies, bounces and opt-outs not linked; Same person can get several e-mails; Revoked Google token prints a traceback. Target: job_id on every lead envelope; Approval page on the loopback API; Default schedule; mail-sync effects, once linked; Contact cooldown; Weekly outcome report. Metric: 0 sends to opted-out or bounced addresses; human reply rate measurable for every send.
